title: Traffic information and jam updates
summary: Feedback on traffic information centers on useful digital reporting for some drivers, while others describe slow, distracting, missing, or subscription-gated traffic jam updates, and several fragments are too ambiguous to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the quality of the digital information and the idea of automatic traffic reports.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe traffic information as frustrating, slow or missing on the map, and distracting or unsafe to use while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention reluctance to pay for traffic features, missing traffic jam information, and general requests for up-to-date traffic support, but the sentiment is not always explicit.

limitations: Several fragments are ambiguous or only indirectly related to traffic information, so the topic includes some unclear sentiment assignments.
One positive example appears unrelated to traffic information, so positive evidence is limited and should be interpreted cautiously.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all vehicles or owners.
